summary: Ported --recipe parent now attaches main's live [5,12] band-stop by default
evidence: dispatch_marker_480.py:386-411 (_train_and_merge sets marker_only_loss=True, never marker_band_stop=False) + sft.py:556 (marker_band_stop default True) + sft.py:830 (attach gate). Original round-1 ran on the pre-band-stop issue-480 branch sft.py with no callback; a bare default launch on this branch would early-stop in [5,12] AND hf_upload=True would overwrite adapters/issue_480/<source>_seed<seed> on HF. One-line fix: marker_band_stop=False in _train_and_merge cfg (the parent recipe IS deliberate saturation, per marker-training-recipe.md). Zero impact on the planned --recipe band_stop run.
